title: Cinema Dream Stairway
description: A woman in a grey coat and red skirt stands on a grand spiral staircase made of film reels and VHS tapes, reaching upward toward a glowing circular opening in a dramatic purple sky. Golden film strips and movie memorabilia cascade down from the portal as theatrical red curtains frame the surreal scene.
prompt: A woman in a grey coat and red skirt stands on a grand spiral staircase constructed from stacked VHS tapes, film reels, and movie posters, reaching her hand up toward a glowing circular portal in a dramatic purple and pink cloudy sky. Golden film strips and movie memorabilia are falling from the opening, theatrical red curtains frame the top, cinematic lighting with a strong spotlight beam, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
